info.name: Azure Service Bus Management Namespaces API
info.description:
The Azure Service Bus REST API provides operations for managing Service Bus resources including namespaces, queues, topics, subscriptions, and rules through the Azure Resource Manager.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Azure
